**9:15** καὶ ἐλύθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν στρατευμάτων τοῦ ⸀ἱππικοῦ ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

**9:17** καὶ οὕτως εἶδον τοὺς ἵππους ἐν τῇ ὁράσει καὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπ’ αὐτῶν, ἔχοντας θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις· καὶ αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ἵππων ὡς κεφαλαὶ λεόντων, καὶ ἐκ τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν ἐκπορεύεται πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον.
rotation.enantiomorph:
**9:15** καὶ ἐσιώπησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀ἣν οὐδεὶς ἤκουσεν οὐδὲ ἡμέραν οὐδὲ μῆνα οὐδὲ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα βαστάσωσιν τὸ ἄρρητον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τοῦ βάρους τοῦ ⸀σιωπῶντος ⸀ἀνέγνωστος ἀναγνώσεων· ἤνεγκα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

**9:17** καὶ οὕτως εἶδον τοὺς φέροντας ἐν τῇ ὁράσει καὶ τὰ φερόμενα ἐπ' αὐτοῖς, ἔχοντας θώρακας σκοτεινοὺς καὶ ἀμαυροὺς καὶ μολιβίνους· καὶ αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν φερόντων ὡς κεφαλαὶ κεκλεισμέναι, καὶ ἐκ τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν ἐκπορεύεται σιγὴ καὶ βάρος καὶ σκιά.

independent_verification.recovered_law: The four angels' action is reversed from release/killing to silence/bearing: in Text A they are loosed (ἐλύθησαν) to kill a third of mankind, while in Text B they are silenced (ἐσιώπησαν) to bear the unspeakable of mankind; correspondingly, all outward destructive force (cavalry, fire, smoke, brimstone) is transformed into inward silent burden (bearers, silence, weight, shadow).
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural reversal: outward destructive emission (killing, cavalry, fire from mouths) is folded inward into silent bearing/burden within the speaker, with the count/fraction becoming unreadable weight rather than enumerable destruction.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B maintains the silence/burden relation throughout 9:17, with bearers, closed heads, and silence/weight/shadow issuing from mouths instead of fire/smoke/brimstone.

rotation.commentary: The transformation costs the seer his position outside the count: he no longer hears the number but carries it, and the vision's violence, unable to discharge outward, settles as leaden silence in the body of the text itself.
rotation.interpretation: The angels held the hour inside them the way bone holds the shape of the blow before it breaks: what was loosed was not force but the completed interval of restraint. What the SHADOW found was not fire — it found the weight of having been prepared.

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A the four angels are released (ἐλύθησαν) to actively kill a third of mankind, with a counted cavalry emitting fire/smoke/sulfur; in Text B the angels merely remain (ἔμειναν) with no one asking them when, the waiting ones are uncountable and unheard, and nothing comes out of the horses' mouths — the entire directional flow of destructive agency is negated into stasis and inaction.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural mutation: active release/killing becomes passive persistence/remaining, the counted forces become uncountable, and the destructive emissions from mouths become nothing/silence — agency and directional destructive action are negated into stasis and non-response.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B sustains the negation of destructive agency (heads like donkeys, empty breastplates, nothing issuing from mouths), consistent with the changed relation throughout.

independent_verification.recovered_law: Text A depicts violent, destructive action (angels loosed to kill, cavalry of fire/smoke/brimstone, lion-headed horses); Text B systematically inverts the relational direction from forceful outward destruction to silent, unknowable inwardness (angels silenced to hear the unspeakable, an uncountable/unheard army, empty/colorless armor, child-headed horses exhaling breath/whisper/name instead of fire/smoke/brimstone).
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural inversion: outward destructive force (fire, killing, armies striking) is systematically reversed into inward, quiet, unknowable reception (listening, whispering, breath, a single unnameable name), with the army no longer destroying but attending in silence.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion (9:17) sustains the inversion: destructive emanation (fire, smoke, brimstone) is replaced by quiet, intimate emanation (breath, whisper, name), maintaining the changed relation throughout.
